english:
A harness and a pair of folding wings, stitched from tarp and tent poles. Fits an outfit.

In mid-air, press Jump to open the wings. Left and Right turn. Forward dives and gains speed; Back pulls up and loses it. Tap Jump to fold the wings.

Run out of speed and you will nosedive, so keep the nose a little below level. A fast dive lets you pull up and climb for a moment, but not for long. A gentle landing is safe. A fast one is not.
